'''Deep 3''' was a [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] used by [[Supreme Warlord]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]],<ref name="Warfare" /> leader of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] splinter faction [[Zero Command]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="Warfare" /> following Harrsk's [[Death/Legends|death]] during<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Imperial Reunification|unification]] of the forces [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the various Deep Core Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] searched abandoned Imperial [[Armory/Legends|armories]] in the Deep Core to gather supplies left over from the [[Imperial Civil War|feuding]] between the various Deep Core Warlords and the [[Operation Shadow Hand|campaigns]] of the Imperial faction known as the [[Dark Empire]]. During his search, Pellaeon discovered the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]] [[Dominion (Star Dreadnought)|''Dominion'']] and ''[[Megador]]'' were abandoned without a crew, though otherwise still [[Realspace/Legends|spaceworthy]], at Deep 3, and claimed them for the reorganized [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deep 3 was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book penned by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
